name: Qurio
author: Qurio

sections.description:
Qurio is a powerful engagement tool designed specifically for media organizations, allowing them to connect directly with their audiences. Using AI-powered surveys and custom engagement campaigns, Qurio helps media sites build trust, grow email subscriptions, and increase revenue. You can easily integrate it into your WordPress site, providing a seamless user experience for both your audience and your team.

Key Features:
– AI-powered surveys to gather audience insights
– Custom engagement campaigns that boost user interaction
– Easy integration with WordPress
– Advanced analytics to track engagement and survey performance

External services

This plugin integrates with an external API to enhance audience engagement. It empowers you to seamlessly embed interactive callouts and feedback forms within your WordPress articles.
To provide valuable insights into audience participation, the plugin collects minimal user interaction data (e.g., engagement metrics, response data). Rest assured, no personal identifiable information (PII) is collected unless voluntarily submitted by the user.
This service is provided by AthensLive Media Solutions P.C.: Terms of use, Privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Download the Qurio plugin and upload it to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Qurio settings page to configure your campaigns and surveys.
sections.faq:
How do I configure surveys?

Once the plugin is activated, navigate to the Qurio settings page, where you can create and customize surveys and campaigns.

Does Qurio support multiple languages?

Currently, Qurio supports English, but additional language support is planned for future releases.
